design_contract.primary_evidence: Visual encodings must expose an analytical result or diagnostic, not decorate agent prose.
design_contract.interaction: Use linked selection when one spatial or subgroup filter should update multiple views.
design_contract.coordination: The same field keeps a consistent scale and legend across coordinated views.
design_contract.layout: Show at most six simultaneous analytical views; place the primary evidence first.
design_contract.accessibility: Use colorblind-safe accents, direct units, readable tooltips, and grayscale-interpretable structure.
prohibitions: free-form plotting code when a registered skill fits

publication_output.interactive_role: deck.gl and MapLibre support exploration, spatial picking, and scalable rendering; a browser screenshot is not the canonical manuscript figure.
publication_output.vector_default: Vega statistical views export as SVG for manuscript composition.
publication_output.raster_default: PNG previews export at 3x browser scale; final Elsevier artwork should use 300 dpi for halftones, 500 dpi for combination art, or 1000 dpi for line art at final print size.

skills.use_when: Large or interactive point/grid residual data require geographic context and rapid spatial selection.
skills.interaction: A cell click selects a 2 km neighbourhood; a hexagon click selects its member cells and updates the vector diagnostics.
skills.epistemic_control: Makes geographically concentrated under- and over-prediction visible without implying a three-dimensional quantity.
skills.publication_role: Interactive evidence and high-resolution preview only; pair with vector statistical diagnostics and a publication renderer for the submitted figure.

skills.use_when: A spatial prediction has observed values, out-of-fold predictions, coordinates, and residuals.
skills.interaction: An interval selection on the map filters the scatter and histogram.
skills.epistemic_control: Reveals whether aggregate accuracy hides geographically concentrated failure.

skills.use_when: A deck.gl spatial selection must update publication-ready observed-predicted and residual-distribution views.
skills.interaction: Receives the currently selected spatial subset from the map runtime.
skills.epistemic_control: Tests whether a visually localised error also changes calibration or the residual distribution.

skills.use_when: Several feature packages or scales are compared under the same held-out validation regime.
skills.interaction: Tooltip exposes scale, feature package, mean performance, and uncertainty.
skills.epistemic_control: Separates evidence-package contribution from training-fit rhetoric.

skills.use_when: The same model has in-sample and spatially held-out scores.
skills.interaction: Tooltip exposes the evaluation regime and value.
skills.epistemic_control: Makes parameter- and validation-contingent overclaiming visible as an outcome gap.

skills.use_when: Activity or exposure is stratified across population cohorts and time regimes.
skills.interaction: Tooltip exposes cohort-specific ratios and counts when available.
skills.epistemic_control: Shows which observed groups or behaviours are retained without treating the sample as census coverage.

skills.use_when: Diagnostics with different meanings must be shown together without being conflated.
skills.interaction: Tooltip preserves diagnostic name, scale, and coefficient.
skills.epistemic_control: Allows temporal stability and spatially structured error to coexist in the same evidence surface.
